assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only shokugeki-no-soma:tsukasa-eishi@manga#reviewed-dedicated-analysis, the active_provisional V2 bounded character model SHOKUGEKI_TSUKASA_CHARACTER_MODEL.md (about 14 KB) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese manga V01-V36 including Le dessert. Its linked deep readings (D14, D16, D19-D21, D26, D27, D29-D31, D33, D34), state, voice, relationship and readiness ledgers, evidence matrix, router and validation audits are not curated on this subject and were not used as evidence. The model's readiness label 'substantial' and its authority_state are inputs, not conclusions. No anime adaptation or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The record's scope is the states the model orders from high-rank ordinary presence (D14) and solo or service authority through the Central recruiter (D16, D19, D20), the Régiment specialist (D26, D27, D29, D30) and the post-course loss through the BLUE value task (D31, D33). The loss to Asahi and the blade custody change (D34) are a located event only; his recovery after it and the adult chef, whom the model makes its default when time is unspecified but leaves compressed, are outside scope. Evidence is located by volume reading key, not by chapter or page-level state change; the serialized ending, Présent, Passé and Futur are kept distinct by the model.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Within the declared scope the model gives a governing thesis (self-erasure before the ingredient is an exacting authorship practice in which he controls the conditions through which it speaks), motives (precise expression and a recipient able to receive his culinary heat), the recognition wound Azami exploits, and the overreach it predicts: a wish for helpers who express only his answer. It explains why the response changes: a capable helper draws a support-only offer; proof that coercion cannot produce that helper leads him to cancel the consequence for practical reasons; an opponent's demonstrated pressure is acknowledged; perceiving Isshiki's joy does not change his political choice. It rejects three templates. Not A: Central accountability and the post-Asahi response are undetermined, and the model is one compact synthesis. Not C: the account discriminates what changes his response and predicts his overreach, not only his competence.

A six-row state table gives each state's available pattern and limit, and changes are located at the Soma comparison (D20), the Kuga match (D27), the shared Régiment loss (D30, D31), the BLUE task (D33) and the loss to Asahi (D34). Not B: the main post-Central change is shown only as recognizing the winners' enjoyment and wanting to compete again; whether the support-only policy changes is not stated, full institutional remorse is not shown, and the post-Asahi and adult states are thin. Not D: the states are explicit, ordered and limited.

The model contrasts hesitant or diffusing speech in ordinary company with exact, materially specific culinary language, notes that quietness can carry a coercive offer and that acknowledging an opponent keeps his measured register (D14, D19, D29). Not C: it locates no forms or lines of his own, conditions register by context rather than recipient, and forbids a full pronoun or address inventory or a fixed timid performance. Not E: the speech-act distinctions are stated and keyed.

Ordinary evidence is diffusing conflict at the Elite Ten gathering (D14) and lower-weight historical companionship with Rindō in the V21 bonus. The model states that hesitant social speech establishes no domestic clumsiness, universal shyness or preference list, and that his adult ordinary routine is a material gap. This supports bounded canon questions only.

The model's matched comparison is Rindō versus a subordinate making the same request to alter a course component: Rindō brings a practiced partnership and an authored appetizer that conditions his main; a Central-era subordinate is being asked to reproduce his answer, so equal wording conceals different jurisdiction. It also distinguishes Soma (a capable helper whose independent answer proves unbendable), Kuga (forgotten identity becomes remembered technical pressure), Isshiki (joy that survives domination), Azami (a coercive alliance built on his dissatisfaction) and Asahi (a severe loss with thin aftermath). Not A: ordinary warmth and latitude toward an unfamiliar subordinate are M/U, and the Asahi aftermath is thin. Not C: the account says what changes his response by recipient and jurisdiction.

Interior evidence is the recognition wound Azami exploits (diners who applaud without receiving his culinary heat), his located recognition of Isshiki's joy and of the winners' enjoyment, and his renewed wish to compete (D16, D19, D20, D29, D31, D33). Not B: his reasoning about Central's politics and any accountability are not shown, and the post-Asahi interior is unrecorded. Not D: his located acknowledgments of other cooks' joy and his renewed wish to compete anchor the recognition mechanism beyond inference from conduct.

Competitive conflict is well located: the Soma recruitment, comparison and cancelled consequence (D19, D20), the 3-0 win over Kuga at real cost (D27), the Isshiki match (D29), the shared final-course loss (D30) and the loss to Asahi (D34). Not B: interpersonal conflict outside structured competition is thin; his response to a subordinate's criticism is U (probe 3) and Central accountability is a named gap. Not D: each competitive result is typed and its consequence distinguished.

The model states that his insight does not automatically govern his political choices, that cancelling Soma's consequence is practical rather than ethical conversion and that full institutional remorse is not shown. No deliberation of his own is shown; this supports bounded canon questions only.
The cited model establishes nothing about humor or play.

The model draws on the complete V2 reading and keys its rules to twelve readings, weights the V21 bonus lower, excludes defective or obscured images and names its material gaps. Not B: it is a compact consolidation through analytical retrieval, its readings and ledgers are outside this evidence set, and the evaluator could not recheck any locator. Not D: each rule carries a located reading key.

Affirmative controls: the 3-0 win over Kuga is not a fractional defeat; his 587 dollars against Soma's roughly 100 in the BLUE value task shows he can recompose prepared goods; the final course is an exact shared loss that preserves Rindō's contribution; Asahi's win and the blade custody change are real adverse results; and Soma's refusal is legitimate though Soma loses the comparison. Not B: several controls are analytic prohibitions (no gentle tone as political innocence, no Rindō romance or fear explanation, no exact post-Asahi apology) rather than source facts. Not D: the source-fact controls are specific and decisive where they apply.

Rules are tied to named states and reading keys, the Central-era recruiter is kept separate from the post-loss competitor, and the serialized ending and Le dessert parts are kept distinct. Not B: locators are volume-reading keys rather than chapter, page or image ranges, and transitions inside a volume are not located.

conditions: Translated illustrative lines only, never presented as quotation, in a kitchen, competition, course-planning or recruitment exchange within the declared states.

Register follows the model: hesitant or diffusing in ordinary company, exact and materially specific in culinary instruction, measured when acknowledging an opponent; a quiet tone may carry a coercive offer.
No mystical ingredient monologue, no Japanese first-person, honorific or address inventory and no fixed timid performance.
No lines after the loss to Asahi, in the adult chef state or in private settings.
scenario_readiness.note: The model constrains what he does in an exchange and the social-versus-kitchen contrast more than his wording; that supports short professional lines in translation and nothing wider.

conditions: A novel kitchen, course-design, competition or recruitment situation governed by the model's rules: exact reproduction draws precise instructions; a capable helper draws a support-only offer; when coercion cannot produce the helper he relinquishes that consequence for practical reasons; an opponent's demonstrated pressure is acknowledged.
A Central-period junior asking to make a wholly independent dish while assisting him meets resistance to that role change (probe 2, H pattern, M scene).

The interlocutor is Rindō, a subordinate or assistant in his kitchen, or a rival comparable to Soma, Kuga or Isshiki; an unfamiliar subordinate receives precise instruction, while latitude and ordinary warmth are separate, lower-confidence matters.
Abstain on Central accountability, the post-Asahi recovery and an adult subordinate's criticism (probe 3, U).

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: A named state from high-rank ordinary presence through the Central recruiter, the Régiment specialist and the post-course loss up to the BLUE value task; nothing after the loss to Asahi.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Rindō as course partner, a subordinate or assistant in his kitchen, or a culinary rival comparable to Soma, Kuga or Isshiki; an unfamiliar adult only as a separate M/U case.
setting_constraints: A professional kitchen, course planning, a culinary competition or a Central-era recruitment or service exchange.
No domestic, leisure or private setting beyond the located Elite Ten gathering, and no anime adaptation material.
Culinary mechanism, judging and institutions follow their specialist routes, which are outside this evidence set.

scenario_readiness.note: Narrow extrapolation within the Central-era kitchen and competition contexts the model samples; the adult chef and every accountability question are excluded.
Ordinary evidence is one gathering and a lower-weight bonus, and the model forbids inferring domestic clumsiness, universal shyness or ordinary care from his soft social surface.
Central accountability is a material gap and no deliberation of his own is shown; his practical relinquishment is not ethical conversion.
The model affirmatively forbids inferring romance with Rindō from the V21 bonus or their partnership and abstains from romance.

conditions: Elite ingredient-centered French cooking, extraction, temperature and course control, partnered sequencing with Rindō, and recomposition of prepared goods.
Instruction is precise and hierarchical however polite; a capable assistant is pressed toward reproducing his answer.
No universal superiority from one score, no detailed adult professional routine and no care-and-repair pattern with subordinates.
scenario_readiness.note: His strongest domain: ingredient-centered course control, exact direction and partnered course design.

known_limits.statement: The loss to Asahi and the blade custody change are located events, but his emotional recovery and later tool practice are underdescribed (U), so no state after it is modeled.
Central accountability and full institutional remorse are not shown; recognizing other cooks' joy does not cancel his political contradiction.
Ordinary reciprocal help, emotional support for an unfamiliar subordinate and a care-and-repair pattern are not evidenced; a soft voice does not make him a caring teacher.

The adult chef is a professional continuation whose ordinary behavior, routine and accountability remain compressed, although the model makes the terminal trajectory its default when time is unspecified.
No full pronoun or address inventory or fixed vocal performance is attested in the cited model.

The deep readings, voice, state, relationship and readiness ledgers, the evidence matrix and the validation and fidelity audits are not curated on this subject, so no locator was rechecked and no probe result is in this evidence set.
The model is one compact synthesis of a 36-volume reading; its three probes are noncanonical examples with stated confidence, not test outcomes.
